facts.statement: The cash flow statement has been prepared under the indirect method as set out in Indian Accounting Standard (Ind AS 7).
facts.quote: The cash flow statement has been prepared under the indirect method as set out in Indian Accounting Standard (Ind AS 7) statement of cash flows.

facts.statement: Investment properties are derecognised when disposed of or permanently withdrawn from use with no future economic benefit expected.
facts.quote: Investment properties are derecognised either when they have been disposed of or when they are permanently withdrawn from use and no future economic benefit is expected from their disposal.

facts.statement: Short-term leases are defined as leases with a lease term of 12 months or less from inception.
facts.quote: short-term leases (defined as leases with a lease term of 12 months or less from inception) and leases of low value assets.

facts.statement: Inventories are valued at the lower of cost and net realisable value using the weighted average cost method.
facts.quote: Inventories are valued at lower of cost and net realisable value. Cost of inventories, comprise costs of purchase and other costs incurred in bringing the inventories to their present condition and location. Cost is determined by the weighted average cost method.

facts.statement: Borrowings are initially recognized at fair value net of transaction costs incurred and subsequently measured at amortized cost.
facts.quote: Borrowings and other financial liabilities are initially recognised at fair value (net of transaction costs incurred). Difference between the fair value and the transaction proceeds on initiation is recognised as an asset / liability based on the underlying reason for the difference. Subsequently all financial liabilities are measured at amortised cost using the effective interest rate method.
